description: A StackChan-inspired typing game with online rankings and optional private event contact.

store.summary: Small keys. Quick fingers. A pocket typing challenge.
store.description: Type short English or programming words in 30-second, 60-second or untimed ten-word rounds. Live WPM, accuracy, typo correction and local personal bests. Optional online challenges share your player name and server-verified score on public leaderboards. Offline play does not connect. A mascot inspired by the official M5Stack StackChan K151 accompanies your rounds. Optional private contact email can be managed on your phone using a short-lived QR code.

ja.summary: 短い単語を打って、速さと正確さに挑戦。小さなキーボードのタイピングゲーム。
